prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a square 3-by-3 atlas of NINE separate painted cutout parts for a male Sun Salutation animation in Inner Breeze.
Primary request: Create the adult male counterpart of the approved ivory-and-moss woman (reference image 2). Match the illustration quality and natural adult male face of reference image 1. He has warm golden-tan skin, chestnut-brown short softly swept hair, modest slightly broad shoulders, a flat male chest, calm small brown eyes and a kind peaceful expression. Plain warm ivory long-sleeve exercise shirt, moss-green yoga trousers and bare feet.
Input images: image 1 is the existing teal-shirt male atlas, used for exact nine-tile layout and the quiet male character style; image 2 is the approved female Sage bun atlas, used for precise ivory/moss colors and golden skin; image 3 is the actual Inbe Sun Salutation banner, used for restrained hand-painted contours and natural anatomy; image 4 is the existing male's isolated torso, used for the detached shoulder-to-hem torso geometry, without arms.
Layout: EXACTLY THREE EQUAL COLUMNS AND THREE EQUAL ROWS, each tile has one centered isolated part with generous transparent margins. Keep every part inside its own tile.
Row 1: (1) right-facing profile MALE HEAD with a complete bare neck extending below the jaw to an ordinary flat neck base, NO CLOTHING on the head; (2) right-facing side-profile IVORY TORSO panel only, from a small round neckline to a relaxed straight hip-length hem, shoulder attachment at upper LEFT and modest flat chest at upper RIGHT, no skin or neck, NO ATTACHED ARM OR SLEEVE; (3) one straight MOSS trousered leg from ordinary upper hip to ankle, WITHOUT foot, no inflated hips or seat.
Row 2: (4) one straight ivory long-sleeved arm with gently rounded shoulder at top and cuff at bottom, WITHOUT hand; (5) upright golden-tan hand with fingers UP, wrist at bottom; (6) horizontal flat golden-tan hand pointing RIGHT, wrist at left.
Row 3: (7) flat golden-tan bare foot pointing RIGHT, ankle above heel at LEFT; (8) golden-tan toe-tucked foot exactly matching reference 1's orientation; (9) golden-tan bare instep foot pointing LEFT with ankle at RIGHT, exactly matching reference 1.
Style/medium: warm hand-painted storybook anime, matte watercolor/gouache textures, subtle paper grain in painted areas, restrained warm contour lines and natural adult proportions. Match both approved existing characters; not a new unrelated style.
Constraints: Actual TRANSPARENT background, no grid, no checkerboard drawn into the art, no numbers, no labels, no words, no shadows, no assembled person, no extra pieces. All skin uses one golden-tan palette; shirt and sleeve have identical ivory colors. The head has bare neck only; the torso neckline has no duplicated neck or skin, so the separately animated neck can tuck smoothly behind the shirt collar. The top is a torso panel, not a complete shirt with attached arms. Preserve the exact tile order and isolated piece orientations. No exaggerated curves or rear contour.
reference_note: Saved reference images are byte-identical copies of the files supplied to built-in image_gen.
